# ClinicBridge AI

ClinicBridge AI is a multilingual AI patient communication platform for medical tourism clinics in Turkey.
It provides a website chat assistant and an AI phone assistant that answer patient questions 24/7 in the patient's language, collect appointment requests, and notify the clinic team by email and WhatsApp.
Clinics can set it up themselves. 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
